title: Alur QC / Rework (Eksekusi Lantai: Output -> QC pass/fail -> Papan Rework -> Packing)
description: Alur bisnis kritikal kendali mutu (Quality Control) & pengerjaan ulang (rework) pada Hub Eksekusi Proses (prod-exec-hub). Setiap potongan/piece mengalir per LINE: hasil proses hulu dicatat sebagai OUTPUT (quick-output), lalu di stasiun QC dicatat pass/fail (qc-event). Piece qc_pass lanjut ke PACKING; piece qc_fail masuk PAPAN REWORK. Di rework (rework-event) piece dipilah: qty_out (rework_pass) lanjut ke PACKING, qty_fail (rework_fail) menjadi scrap, dengan invariant qty_out + qty_fail <= qty_in. Board per proses & flow-summary menampilkan throughput + WIP + bottleneck. QC via quick-output dilarang (harus qc-event), dan invariant rework dijaga guardrail.
happy_path_steps: Catat OUTPUT proses hulu (quick-output) untuk sebuah line -> event_type=output
QC event: qty_pass -> Packing, qty_fail -> Papan Rework (event qc_pass/qc_fail)
Rework event: qty_in dari qc_fail, qty_out -> rework_pass (Packing), qty_fail -> rework_fail (scrap)
Packing: quick-output pada proses PACKING mencatat throughput packing
Board per proses + flow-summary menampilkan throughput, WIP, qc_pass/qc_fail, bottleneck
verification: backend API POC ALL PASS (output->qc pass/fail->rework out/fail->packing; flow-summary qc_pass/qc_fail akurat; guard qc-via-quick-output 400; guard rework invariant qty_out+qty_fail>qty_in 400; guard qc-event tanpa qty 400); E2E UI PASS (QC->Rework->Packing via prod-exec-hub, no logout)
notes_qa: Observasi: flow-summary out('REWORK') memakai event_type='output' sehingga throughput REWORK (rework_pass/rework_fail) tidak terhitung -> dicatat di _qa (Low, tidak memblok flow inti).
